description.value: Perched above the waters of Horseshoe Bay, Olive & Anchor is a casual West Coast dining spot serving scratch-made lunches and dinners in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere. Chef Lisa Kim brings a fine-dining background to a menu of elevated comfort food, complemented by a curated wine list and a selection of local craft and imported beers. Situated 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver in Horseshoe Bay, it makes a natural mid-route stop for cyclists exploring the North Shore.

address.value: 6418 Bay St, West Vancouver, BC V7W 2H1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for https://oliveandanchor.com/ loaded successfully and confirms the business name, full address (6418 Bay St, West Vancouver, BC V7W 2H1), and phone (604.921.8848). No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all three required criteria remain null.
